projectName: SafePay Guardian - Ethereum-Powered UPI Fraud Shield
problemStatement: UPI fraud is an epidemic with users losing money to scams within minutes. Vulnerable users lack tools to verify callers, and existing apps optimize for speed over safety.
solution: SafePay Guardian: An Ethereum-Powered UPI Fraud Shield. Creates smart escrow links for risky payments, routing funds through a smart contract with an AI-driven risk engine before releasing them.

projectName: CaneIQ - Precision AI Cane Quality Assessment
problemStatement: Traditional laboratory analysis of cane quality is slow, manual, and prone to human error, causing delays in sugar mills and lack of real-time process optimization.
solution: CaneIQ: Precision AI for Real-Time Cane Quality Assessment. A non-intrusive, plug-and-play system for online sugar percentage measurement in sugar mills using AI and IoT sensors.

problemStatement: Inadequate health literacy (9/10 Indians) and language barriers cause poor medication adherence and 'repetition factories' at PHCs. NCDs drive 50% of deaths, yet patients leave clinics confused about their care plans.
solution: JanMitra Health: AI-powered patient communication bridge. Converts prescriptions and voice notes into multilingual, actionable care plans (text/voice/WhatsApp). Features multimodal input intake, medical RAG for grounded advice, and hallucination audits.

organizer: Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT Vellore) in collaboration with SanDisk
problemStatement: Storage devices degrade silently (87% of users ignore SMART metrics), 40-60% of cloud budgets wasted on improper tiering, fragmented local+cloud storage with no unified orchestration, and compression guesswork.
solution: AI-native orchestration platform combining XGBoost-based drive health prediction from SMART telemetry, K-means access pattern classification, risk-aware tiering engine, compression ROI optimizer, multi-cloud cost arbitrage (AWS/Azure/GCP), and risk-cost trade-off optimizer — exposed via a FastAPI backend and React+Vite dark-themed dashboard.

projectName: NPS Saarthi - Offline-First Digital NPS Onboarding
organizer: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA) in collaboration with SIIC, IIT Kanpur
problemStatement: 78 million eligible citizens in India miss out on ₹1.2 trillion in annual government benefits due to language barriers, digital illiteracy, and poor connectivity. Need seamless digital NPS onboarding with simplified KYC.
solution: India's first offline-first, voice-assisted, consent-driven NPS onboarding PWA. Enables compliant KYC, consent capture, and account creation entirely offline with AES-256 encrypted local storage, auto-syncs when connectivity returns. Features multilingual + voice support in 8 Indian languages, multi-path KYC (DigiLocker/Aadhaar/Manual), and DPDP Act 2023-compliant digital consent receipts.

projectName: AetherLab - Edge-Native Vision Tutor for Engineering Mastery
hackathonName: AMD RYZEN Slingshot - National Startup Idea Challenge
problemStatement: India's engineering graduates lack practical lab skills due to 1:60 teacher-to-student ratios, static/outdated manuals, and English-language barriers — over 80% deemed unemployable.
solution: A multimodal, eyes-on AI tutor running locally on AMD Ryzen AI laptops. Uses a webcam as a smart lab assistant with a quantized Vision-Language Model on AMD Ryzen NPU for real-time video analysis. Compares physical lab setup against digitized manual diagrams, detects anomalies, and provides voice-guided corrections in native languages (Hindi/Tamil/Marathi) — fully offline and privacy-first.

organizer: N. L. Dalmia Institute of Management Studies and Research (NLDIMSR) via Apna
problemStatement: How India's consumption economy can scale towards 2030 while embedding sustainability through responsible consumption, resource efficiency, and long-term value creation.
solution: Multi-stage research paper competition analyzing India's consumption economy. Proposed a Circular-Digital Model for Tier-2/3 cities focusing on Consumer Nudges, Circular Business Models (Rental/Refurb), and Policy Levers (EPR+ONDC) to align USD 6T growth with SDG 12.

problemStatement: VoltRide: When Green Growth Meets Operational Reality — Analyze a business case study on EV fleet operations covering stress analysis, cancellations, utilization, charging alignment, and impact-effort recommendations.
solution: Business case report with 5 analytical artifacts: stress heatmap, Pareto cancellations analysis, utilization analysis, charging alignment, and impact-effort matrix for EV fleet operational optimization.

projectName: Agentic Honey-Pot for Scam Detection & Intelligence Extraction
problemStatement: Build an AI-powered Agentic Honey-Pot system that detects scam messages and autonomously engages scammers to extract actionable intelligence (bank accounts, UPI IDs, phishing links) through multi-turn conversations.
solution: Production-ready FastAPI backend acting as an intelligent honey-pot. Uses rule-based scam detection (keyword/urgency/payment-redirect heuristics) and when scam is detected, an AI Agent powered by Groq (llama-3.1-8b-instant) activates, impersonating a believable persona to waste scammer time. Regex-based intelligence extraction auto-captures bank accounts, UPI IDs, phishing links, and phone numbers.

projectName: MechGuide - The Autonomous AI Repair Co-Pilot
problemStatement: Millions of tons of repairable machinery are discarded because diagnosing and fixing them is too complex for average users; professional mechanics are expensive and scarce in many regions.
solution: Autonomous AI repair co-pilot using Gemini 3's multimodal live vision to diagnose machinery in real-time via smartphone camera. Overlays AR repair guides (Three.js bounding boxes), provides voice-guided step-by-step instructions, and maintains long-horizon context across multi-hour repair sessions. Built with Next.js 16, React 19, Three.js, and Framer Motion.

projectName: India's Invisible Citizens - Bridging Aadhaar Exclusion Zones
problemStatement: Despite Aadhaar's 1.3B+ enrollments, significant exclusion zones persist — children (0-5), remote/tribal areas (174 districts), and migrant populations face high barriers to enrollment.
solution: 4-stage data pipeline analyzing 5.4M+ records: (1) EDA mapping exclusion hotspots, (2) Gradient Boosting Classifier with 99% accuracy predicting exclusion risk, (3) cost-benefit optimized intervention plan deploying 100 Mobile Enrollment Units across 174 high-risk districts in a 21-month phased rollout, (4) impact projection showing ₹254Cr benefit vs ₹7.25Cr cost (35:1 ROI, 450K+ citizens reached).

projectName: SchemaSetu - Voice-First Proactive AI Platform for Government Schemes
problemStatement: 78 million eligible citizens in India miss out on ₹1.2 trillion in annual government benefits due to language barriers (70% rural India speaks only local languages), digital illiteracy (450M Indians), and poor connectivity (400M on 2G).
solution: Voice-first, proactive AI platform that calls users proactively when eligible for schemes via IVR, remembers household context using Neo4j graph database, works on 2G networks (<500KB per query) with IVR fallback, and supports 22 languages + 40 dialects via AI4Bharat. Achieves 92% ML eligibility matching across 1000+ government schemes. Multi-channel access via WhatsApp Bot, IVR, Web Portal, and Mobile App.

projectName: BirdThreat AI - Predictive Crop Protection Platform
organizer: Government of Tamil Nadu (Entrepreneurship Development and Innovation Institute)
problemStatement: Birds destroy 15-30% of sunflower/maize/jowar yields in Tamil Nadu's rainfed farms, costing farmers ₹10,000/acre annually. Need a software solution for detection, forecasting, and deterrence.
solution: Flutter/Streamlit app where farmers upload crop field photos/videos. YOLOv8 detects birds in real-time (95% accuracy), LSTM predicts infestation risk over 7 days using IMD weather APIs + historical crop data. Generates optimal deterrence alerts. Edge AI runs fully on-device offline via TensorFlow Lite with federated learning and AR field overlays.

projectName: BHASHINI VaniSangam - AI-Powered Multilingual Learning Ecosystem
problemStatement: AI-Powered Multilingual Learning and Interaction Ecosystem for Classrooms and Student Engagement — bridging language barriers in Indian classrooms.
solution: AI-driven, multilingual, edge-first learning ecosystem integrating BHASHINI APIs for real-time speech recognition, translation, and transcription. Features live subtitles, auto-generated multilingual notes, gamified peer-to-peer communication tools, interactive games (quizzes, puzzles, storytelling), and offline/edge-based processing for low-connectivity environments.

projectName: SmartGuard - Unobtrusive Fall Detection for Elderly
problemStatement: 500,000+ elderly Indians fall annually. Existing wearable solutions have <30% adoption because 70% of elderly refuse them due to discomfort, stigma, and forgetfulness.
solution: SmartGuard: Passive fall detection system using smartphone cameras and AI-powered pose estimation (MediaPipe) to alert caregivers instantly. Works offline, privacy-first, and requires NO wearables.

projectName: DeepTrust Guardian - Real-Time Deepfake Detection Firewall
problemStatement: 680% YoY increase in deepfake activity. 1 in 4 adults targeted. Existing solutions fail to detect AI-powered voice cloning in real-time calls effectively.
solution: World's first privacy-preserving call authenticity firewall. Uses Android Accessibility Service to detect calls, captures audio in 300ms windows using volatile RAM (Last-Mile Capture), and combines Wav2Vec2 + YOLOv8/FastVLM for on-device verification with 80ms inference latency.

projectName: Smart Group Tour Platform - AI-Powered Event Travel OS
problemStatement: Fragmented communication, time-intensive coordination, and lack of real-time visibility in group travel planning for MICE and weddings leading to budget overruns.
solution: AI-Powered Event Travel Operating System features Smart Event Travel OS for automated orchestration, Guest Personalization Engine for microsites/concierge, and Predictive Inventory Optimizer for demand forecasting. Reduces planning time by 85% and improves conversion by 3x.
